text_block_list.text:
One day, as summer training camp was 
drawing to a close—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(...This year's summer training camp was 
over in the blink of an eye, too.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Once we get back to the academy, autumn 
will be here in no time—)
...I've been looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Fréjus...!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"Long time no see" might be the 
appropriate greeting. We haven't spoken 
like this since the Kikuka Sho, have we?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: Well, setting that aside—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace-san. Please, run a serious 
match race with me right now.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to hold back. I am going 
in intending to defeat you. ...Will you 
accept?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(What incredible drive...!! The pressure 
of someone determined to pass me no matter 
what...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: LIKE HELL I'LL LOOOOOOSE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Haa... I fell short, didn't I? You 
truly are strong. But――

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Were you able... to feel it? My... will to 
fight.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! It felt like their raw spirit was 
piercing right through me from behind...!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...Watching your races from the shadows up 
until today, there is something I've come 
to realize.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...In the past, I spent my days striving 
to achieve proud results, so as not to 
bring shame upon my heritage."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"I truly believed that was my duty. 
...However, putting it another way—"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
I was born into privilege. Standing on the 
favored side. ...You could say I was 
self-aware of that fact.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"You once described that self-awareness as 
'fighting while carrying the weight of my 
heritage.'"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
However... this is precisely my wicked 
hubris. And the true nature of my petty, 
insignificant self.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
When faced with CB-san, witnessing her raw 
talent, having my spirit broken all on my 
own...—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
If we look at the root of the issue, this 
happened precisely because I considered 
myself to be "one of the superior ones" 
and distinguished between myself and 
others.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
It is only because I arbitrarily singled 
out CB-san as superior—as an existence 
from "another world"—that I fell into such 
a mindset.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: —You are different.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"You make no such distinctions. No matter 
how formidable an opponent stands before 
you, you never brush them off as being 
from 'another world.'"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why you can keep moving 
forward. ...Why you can keep taking on 
challenges."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"Watching your races up until now... 
helped me realize that."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"Today, following your example up to now, 
I tore down all boundaries between us and 
challenged you with the pure mindset of 
simply 'winning.'"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
If you could truly feel that resolve... 
then—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“—I felt it. ...Fiercely and 
passionately!”

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
………………There could be no greater 
encouragement than that.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...I intend to aim for a comeback in a 
graded race held this autumn.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"And from there, I will fight on once 
more. Just like you, so that one day I may 
make waves of my own."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Fréjus...!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...The next race was the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...It's been a while since I ran a 
GⅠ with C.B.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please show the world beyond a 
shadow of a doubt— —just who Mr. C.B.'s 
true rival is.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
And hopefully... the glory of the Shield 
will be in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. —Let's both give it our all out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: ...? ...Ah, I see.
(――BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: ...High-fiving is quite nice, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Pretty cool, right?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...Ace-san. I'm truly, truly glad we're 
in the same generation."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Please, race across this era. As our... 
"ace."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Summer's coming to an end, huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —It's the autumn of showdowns.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks again, Trainer. This summer, 
seriously... you took care of me even more 
than usual."
choice_data_list: Because I promised to make you the "ace."
Because I told you I'd make you the "ace."

text_block_list.text:
"So it's nothing to brag about. I only did 
what any trainer for Katsuragi Ace would 
do."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. Trainer-san has been 
fighting alongside me this whole time――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back to the academy. —So we can 
fight again tomorrow.

The stage for our decisive battle, the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), is fast approaching—
